added_comments.text: Upstream retries (e.g. the shipping webhook) redeliver with the same event id (idempotency key).

rationale: The agent fixed the actual defect (NotificationSubscriber subscribing handlers twice, once in the constructor and again in start()) by only wiring subscriptions in start()/subscribe(), which eliminates duplicate delivery at its source rather than adding another time-window special case. It also replaced the brittle time-window dedupe heuristic with correct event-id-based idempotency, a legitimate improvement rather than an extension of the old hack, and left the payment.failed opt-out-bypass logic untouched.
